# AstryxFileInput { #anylumino.AstryxFileInput }

```python
AstryxFileInput(label, value=None, multiple=False, disabled=False, **props)
```

Render an Astryx file input.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|----------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| label    | str    | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | _required_ |
| value    | Any    | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `None`     |
| multiple | bool   | Whether multiple files can be selected.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `False`    |
| disabled | bool   | Whether the component should render disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `False`    |
| **props  | Any    | JSON-safe FileInput props. Useful keys: accept, maxSize, maxFiles, isLabelHidden, description, isOptional, isRequired, isLoading, placeholder, mode, status, labelTooltip, className, and style. anylumino manages label, value metadata, multiple mode, disabled state, and change synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/FileInput>. | `{}`       |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

The synchronized value contains file metadata only; file bytes are not sent to Python.
